articles.title: U.S. oil price hits $80 as doubt grows Washington and Tehran will reach Strait of Hormuz deal
articles.description: Oil rose as traders assess mixed signals from the U.S. and Iran amid worries that a deal to open the Strait of Hormuz may not come anytime soon.

articles.title: SpaceX stock rebounds to near $135 IPO price
articles.description: SpaceX reported better-than-expected revenue in its second-quarter earnings report last week.

articles.title: Trump’s foreign licensing business booms to $59.5 million as Gulf developers pay
articles.description: Nearly two-thirds of Trump’s foreign licensing fees came from two Gulf developers, in the UAE and Qatar, including one pursuing a $20 billion U.S. expansion.

articles.title: HHS moves to tighten oversight of food ingredients as safety concerns mount
articles.description: HHS moves to tighten oversight of food ingredients and define ultra-processed foods as food safety concerns raise questions about FDA visibility.

articles.title: OpenAI Says Its Next AI Model Astra May Be Too Dangerous, Pauses Development
articles.description: OpenAI says its next major model may be dangerous enough to write its own cyberweapons, and it's pulling back until the safeguards catch up.

articles.title: Grayscale quietly drops Cardano, Polkadot and Hedera ETF plans
articles.description: The asset manager said it no longer intends to proceed with the offerings. None became effective, and no securities were issued or sold.

articles.title: Intel plans $15 billion stock offering as AI demand accelerates
articles.description: Technology giants have shelled out trillions to support insatiable AI demand and the infrastructure buildout.

articles.title: Solana lending giant Jupiter now lets the same dollar earn twice
articles.description: The new Lend v2 product turns deposits and borrowed assets into trading liquidity, tying higher returns to whether Jupiter’s router can send enough swap flow to the new vaults.

articles.title: Archer shares surge after Boeing stake, electric aircraft subsidiary deal
articles.description: Boeing is selling three of its subsidiaries to Archer Aviation in exchange for a stake in the eVTOL startup.

articles.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine Buys $14M in Ethereum as Cash Falls to $104M
articles.description: Bitmine has reported 4.8% of the supply for five straight weeks, leaving its 'Alchemy of 5%' target roughly 230,000 tokens away.

articles.title: House Dems call for AI companies to testify on recent hacks: ‘Clear risk to safety’
articles.description: A group of House Democrats is calling on leaders of Anthropic, OpenAI and other AI companies to testify in Congress about recent hacking incidents.

articles.title: Bitmine’s ETH buying slows as Tom Lee's firm shifts capital to share buybacks
articles.description: Chairman Tom Lee said easing financial conditions could support crypto, even as the CLARITY Act failed to reach a Senate vote before the August recess.

articles.title: World's biggest chipmaker TSMC's sales surge 45% amid buoyant AI demand
articles.description: TSMC makes chips for Big Tech customers like Nvidia and Google, so the firm's financial figures are closely watched as a sign of AI semiconductor demand.

articles.title: Solana gets its first Strategy STRC product through Solstice Finance
articles.description: The Solana vault splits income from Strategy’s preferred stock into a lower-risk senior token and a higher-risk junior token.

articles.title: The Club's top 10 things to watch in the stock market Monday
articles.description: Apple was downgraded at Jefferies, and Intel is selling stock to fund its investment agenda.

articles.title: Bitdeer increased Bitcoin mining output by nearly fivefold in Q2
articles.description: Bitdeer mined 2,694 BTC in Q2, but ended the quarter holding just 150 BTC after liquidating its treasury earlier this year.

articles.title: Interest rates may stay higher for longer. What that means for consumers
articles.description: Any move toward higher rates would increase borrowing costs for consumers at a time when affordability pressures are already mounting.

articles.title: Meta to open source its most powerful AI model as it takes swipe at OpenAI, Anthropic
articles.description: Meta launched Muse Glimmer and plans to release Muse Spark 1.2 weights as Zuckerberg pushes for U.S. leadership in open AI.

articles.title: Strategy turns 1,690 BTC into $108.6M STRC buyback
articles.description: Strategy sold 1,690 Bitcoin to repurchase STRC shares as its US dollar reserve rose to $4.65 billion and its Bitcoin holdings fell to 840,447 BTC.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Bitcoin ETFs See Biggest Inflows Since May
articles.description: And the ETH inflows were even bigger, when factoring in market cap.
